name: GPT-3 175B
summary: The GPT-3 paper published the largest model's scale and its alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention pattern.

stages.title: Token sequence
stages.summary: The paper reports a 2,048-token context window.

stages.title: Width-12,288 residual stream
stages.summary: Embedding output enters the published model width.

stages.title: Dense and locally banded attention
stages.summary: Ninety-six layers alternate dense and locally banded sparse attention and use 96 heads.

stages.title: Feed-forward path
stages.summary: The paper states that feed-forward width is four times the model width.

stages.title: Few-shot language-model output
stages.summary: Tasks and demonstrations are supplied through text without gradient updates during evaluation.
